sloka: भाषमाणम् महात्मानम् राज पुत्र्यौ प्रसाद्य तम् ।ऊचतुः परम प्रीते कृतांजलि पुटे तदा ॥१-३८-९॥
transliteration: bhāṣamāṇam mahātmānam rāja putryau prasādya tam ।ūcatuḥ parama prīte kṛtāṁjali puṭe tadā ॥1-38-9॥

translations.english: Thereafter, both the daughters of the king were exceedingly delighted. Having propitiated that magnanimous asectic both of them with folded hands in supplication, said:
